14,Competitive Positioning,check_question,A prospect says they already have Wiz and feel their AI security needs are covered. How do you respond?,"## Handling the ""We Already Have Wiz"" Objection
This is a common and understandable objection — Wiz is a strong platform and customers trust it. Your goal is to **reframe scope, not attack Wiz.**
### The Core Message
> *""Wiz does cloud AI posture really well. Atlas does full AI lifecycle security. These are not the same scope — and most organizations need both.""*
### What Wiz Actually Covers (Acknowledge It)
Be credible by giving Wiz credit:
- ✅ Cloud AI asset discovery (AWS/Azure/GCP models and endpoints)
- ✅ AI-BOM with graph correlation to data paths
- ✅ Misconfiguration detection for cloud-hosted AI resources
### Where Wiz Stops (The Gap Atlas Fills)

column2: OWASP LLM Top 10 / NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act mapping
